author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
A sequel to the DTM map, Ruby Jungle




Contest entry; Just something I whipped up out of boredom; not really good compared to the other map in the contest (Pavlo's) but mine alright I guess. It's more than anything a remake of an older map of mine that was a OiTC, but anywho this was a solo project. Expect a third Ruby Jungle soon and a new Periculum. Without further ado~
